name: cv-application-tracker
title: Application Lifecycle Tracker and Funnel Metrics
summary: Deterministic state machine managing candidate applications, pipeline stages, and conversion funnels.
known_limitations: State transitions must adhere to valid pipeline stages: Wishlist -> Applied -> Interviewing -> Offer -> Closed.

cv:application-tracker/tracker@0.1.0#par.summary: Parses board TOML and computes conversion funnel metrics.

cv:application-tracker/tracker@0.1.0#add.summary: Adds a new application entry to the board.

cv:application-tracker/tracker@0.1.0#adv.summary: Transitions an application to a new lifecycle stage.

cv:application-tracker/tracker@0.1.0#log.summary: Logs an interview round or interaction event.
